announcements.headline: Strong Profitability from Italian Gas Production
announcements.insight: Strong profitability from Italian gas production follows recent PV expansion and Tunisian oil resumption, indicating operational progress across multiple assets.

announcements.headline: Zenith Surpasses 240 MWp Target with New Project
announcements.insight: Zenith Energy LTD.Com Shs NPV (DI) has reached its 240 MWp target following recent acquisitions in Lombardy and Puglia. This milestone confirms progress on its development pipeline.

announcements.headline: Resumption of Oil Production in Tunisia
announcements.insight: Zenith Energy LTD.Com Shs NPV (DI) resumes oil production in Tunisia, marking a significant operational shift from its recent focus on Italian solar acquisitions. Shareholders should monitor how this new activity integrates with the company's existing portfolio.

announcements.headline: New 5 MWp PV Development Project in Puglia
announcements.insight: Zenith Energy LTD.Com Shs NPV (DI) (ZEN) continues its Italian expansion with a new PV project, following recent acquisitions in September and October.

announcements.headline: Exercise of Warrants & Notice of AGM
Hon Michael R. Pompeo appointed as Advisor
announcements.insight: Zenith Energy LTD.Com Shs NPV (DI) appointed Hon Michael R. Pompeo as Advisor. This follows recent Italian PV acquisitions and cash growth updates.

announcements.headline: Acquisition of 10 MWp PV & Production Update
announcements.insight: Zenith Energy continues its acquisition strategy with another PV project, following earlier purchases in September. This reinforces its growth trajectory established by surpassing the 200 MWp target.

announcements.headline: Acquisition of 11 MWp PV in Lombardy
announcements.insight: Zenith Energy continues its Italian expansion by acquiring an additional 11 MWp PV asset, following a previous 9 MWp purchase in September. This reinforces the strong cash generation update reported earlier this month.

announcements.headline: Acquisition: 9 MWp PV development project in Italy
announcements.insight: This acquisition extends Zenith Energy LTD.Com Shs NPV (DI) (ZEN)'s Italian presence following recent biogas and cash generation updates. It signals continued expansion in the region.

announcements.headline: Strong Growth in Italian Energy Cash Generation
announcements.insight: Italian biogas plant acquisition follows MoU for solar asset sale. This diversifies the portfolio beyond the 200 MWp solar target reached in August.

announcements.headline: Update on ICC-2 Arbitration
announcements.insight: Zenith Energy LTD.Com Shs NPV (DI) provides an update on ICC-2 arbitration. This follows recent acquisitions and financing activities from July and August 2026.

announcements.headline: Share Issuance under ATM Facility & TVR
Zenith surpasses 200 MWp solar development target
announcements.insight: Zenith surpasses its 200 MWp solar development target, exceeding the 193 MWp pipeline noted in July. This milestone follows recent acquisitions and financing activities.

announcements.headline: Total Voting Rights
Financing in Norway
announcements.insight: Financing in Norway follows the July solar pipeline expansion and biogas acquisition. This suggests continued capital deployment to support recent asset growth.

announcements.headline: Acquisition of Italian Biogas Plant
announcements.insight: The Italian Biogas Plant acquisition expands the solar pipeline established in July. This follows the Rome acquisition and a sale MoU, indicating active portfolio development.

announcements.headline: MoU for sale of 50 MWp for EUR 12 million
announcements.insight: The sale of 50 MWp follows the Rome acquisition which expanded the solar pipeline to 193 MWp. This disposal represents a significant step in managing the newly acquired assets.

announcements.headline: Rome acquisition brings solar pipeline to 193 MWp
announcements.insight: The Rome acquisition expands the solar pipeline to 193 MWp, following the June construction update. This marks a significant step in project development.

announcements.headline: Establishment of At-the-Market Equity Programme
announcements.insight: Zenith Energy LTD.Com Shs NPV (DI) establishes an equity programme to raise capital. This follows its recent investment in Reveille Resources PLC and admission to Aquis Growth Market.

announcements.headline: Update on ICC-2 Arbitration
announcements.insight: Zenith Energy LTD.Com Shs NPV (DI) updates its ICSID arbitration against Tunisia, following the June 26 filing. This legal action is critical for enforcing rights related to the Italian renewable energy scheme.

announcements.headline: Reveille Resources admitted to Aquis Growth Market
announcements.insight: Following the July investment, Reveille Resources admitted to Aquis Growth Market. This listing event follows the earlier capital injection into the entity.

announcements.headline: Further Investment in Reveille Resources PLC
announcements.insight: Zenith Energy makes another acquisition following its June purchases. This further investment in Reveille Resources expands its portfolio.

announcements.headline: Construction of first solar project, Italy
announcements.insight: Construction of the first solar project follows the June acquisition of PV development in Rome. This marks a key execution step for the Italian renewable energy scheme.

announcements.headline: ICSID Arbitration against the Republic of Tunisia
announcements.insight: Zenith Energy LTD.Com Shs NPV (DI) initiates ICSID arbitration against Tunisia, a significant legal development following its recent Italian renewable energy scheme announcement in June.

announcements.headline: €23 billion Italian renewable energy scheme
announcements.insight: This €23 billion scheme follows the June acquisition of a Rome PV development, indicating significant expansion into Italian renewable energy assets.

announcements.headline: Acquisition of PV development in Rome, Italy
announcements.insight: Zenith Energy acquires a PV development in Rome. This follows exclusivity agreements for Daybreak O & G announced in June 2026.

announcements.headline: Exclusivity Agreements to acquire Daybreak O & G
announcements.insight: Zenith Energy LTD.Com Shs NPV (DI) has entered exclusivity agreements to acquire Daybreak O & G. This follows its preliminary financial results in June 2026.

announcements.headline: Preliminary Unaudited Financial Results
announcements.insight: Zenith Energy LTD.Com Shs NPV (DI) has released preliminary unaudited financial results. As this is the first such filing on record, shareholders should monitor subsequent disclosures for detailed performance metrics.
